Overlapping bold/italic tags are recovered by the HTML parser without panic

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p><b><i>bold and italic</b></i></p>");
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
